newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $62, off $1 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $62, off $1 -USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower than last Tuesday.
Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,200 slaughter steers and 2,500 heifers; 3,700 head confirmed for week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 62.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 62.00.
